info.title: Pragati Bharti Document Intelligence API
info.description: Production-grade, scalable document intelligence and question extraction service for exam and question-bank material. Converts arbitrary PDF and image layouts into structured, machine-readable question banks with answers, bounding boxes, and confidence metrics.

get.description: Kubernetes / Docker liveness probe: verifies process is alive and responsive.
Readiness probe: verifies active database and Redis connectivity.
Prometheus-compatible plain text metrics endpoint.

post.description: Authenticate with email and password to receive JWT access and refresh tokens.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access and refresh token pair.

get.description: Retrieve profile and role of currently authenticated user.

post.description:
Upload an exam PDF or image (JPG/PNG).
Returns immediately with HTTP 202 Accepted and a document ID for asynchronous background processing.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of uploaded documents for the current user.

post.description: Upload multiple files simultaneously and optionally auto-group them.

get.description: Retrieve metadata, current status, and stage timings for a specific document.

delete.description: Delete a document, its extracted pages, questions, and storage objects.
